notes:
Repair pass r2 on 10 plants. All new or changed stated quotes were checked against the live page with tools/fetch_page.py --check (fragments joined by ' ... ' were checked one by one); all found. No plant found closed or moved.
Opening lines: each plant's opening_line now has a composed row (inferred, source_url blank) AND the old row that cited a source_url is overwritten with the same inferred text and a blank quote, so no stale 'stated' opening line survives the merge. The blank-url row is the intended one; the old-key rows can be dropped if a duplicate is unwanted.
Findings: (1) CHM Saginaw: chmutility.com labels 700 E McLeroy Blvd Saginaw the 'Corporate Office' and says its production is in Fort Worth; Saginaw is kept only on the MassDOT/GA DOT/AISC listings and its prospect_test stays inferred; keystonepoles.com (the old website value) does not resolve, so website now points to chmutility.com. (2) Structural & Steel Products Fort Worth is confirmed operating: Race Rock's facilities page lists the Fort Worth fabrication facility at 3001 W Pafford St (177,000 sq ft) and TxDOT lists plant 99951 Fort Worth; the old s-steel.com website does not resolve, website now racerock.com. A Georgia QPL-57 row gives a different Fort Worth address (3900 Lubbock Ave) and was retagged inferred.
